description: This PHP source file defines a class `ContactsViewValidPortalUsername` that extends `SugarView`. It provides an AJAX handler method `display()` to check if a given portal username already exists in the contacts database, used for validation in the SuiteCRM system. The class notably processes incoming requests and outputs the count of matching contacts with a specific `portal_name`.

classes.name: ContactsViewValidPortalUsername
classes.description: A class extending SugarView, providing an AJAX endpoint to validate if a portal username exists in contacts.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the process call, invokes display to produce output.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Executes a database query to count contacts with the given portal_name and outputs the count.
